tour.title: See QueueSense in 2 minutes
tour.disclaimer: All screens on this page are samples. Nothing here is saved or added to any real workplace.
tour.s1.title: Customers scan a QR and see the wait
tour.s1.text: At the entrance, a customer scans your QR code. Before joining they see an honest range with a confidence label, in your colours and fonts.
tour.s1.p1: No app to install, no sign-up, no phone number
tour.s1.p2: Estimates are a range, never fake precision
tour.s2.title: They get a live ticket
tour.s2.text: One tap gives an anonymous ticket like R-012 with their position and a wait range that updates by itself.
tour.s2.p1: Updates live as staff serve people
tour.s2.p2: Can let 2 people go ahead, cancel or share on WhatsApp
tour.s3.title: Staff tap one button per customer
tour.s3.text: On any phone, staff press NEXT (or SEATED / LEFT for tables). That single tap is all the data QueueSense needs.
tour.s3.p1: Big buttons, usable with one thumb
tour.s3.p2: Undo for 2 minutes, keyboard shortcuts on laptops
tour.s4.title: Customers are called at the right moment
tour.s4.text: When a table or counter frees up, the engine picks the right person, explains why, and their phone shows exactly where to go.
tour.s4.p1: Smallest table that fits the group
tour.s5.title: You see everything live
tour.s5.text: The operator website shows the queue, the wait for new arrivals and how busy you are, plus analytics and a what-if simulator.
tour.s5.p1: Learns real service times from staff taps
tour.s5.p2: Try 'add 1 counter' before you add staff
tour.s6.title: Ready to set up your place?
tour.s6.text: Create a free operator account, add your workplace, choose your colours and fonts, and print your QR code.
tour.s6.p1: Two websites per workplace: customer and operator
tour.s6.panelText: Sign up, create a workplace, print the QR. That's it.
